chunks: Aban ibn Uthman narrated from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far عليه السلام say: "Whoever drinks wine and becomes intoxicated from it, no salat (prayer) will be accepted from him for forty days. If he abandons the salat (prayer) during these days, the punishment will be doubled for him due to his abandoning the salat (prayer)."
ai.seo_question: What happens if someone drinks alcohol and misses prayer for forty days in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that intoxication from wine causes a person's salat (prayer) to be unaccepted for forty days. It also emphasizes that abandoning salat (prayer) during that period is an additional grave sin that brings increased punishment.
